Name: Geode Crusher Expanded
Author: Jeweloki
Description:
[heading]Description[/heading]
[b]Artifact Trove Crusher expands the Geode Crusher's functionality by allowing it to process both Artifact Troves and Sunberry Artifacts. Simply place either item into the Geode Crusher with a piece of Coal, wait for it to finish, and collect the rewards—just like using the vanilla Geode Crusher.[/b]
[line]
[heading]Installation Instructions[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [b]SMAPI[/b]. [/*]
[*]Download and extract this mod. [/*]
[*]Place the extracted mod folder into your
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code]directory. [/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.

Or just use Vortex[/*]
[/list][line]
[heading]Main Features[/heading]
[list]
[*] Adds support for Artifact Troves in the Geode Crusher. [/*]
[*] Adds support for Sunberry Artifacts from Sunberry Village.[/*]
[*] Rewards are identical to opening the items normally. [/*]
[*] Lightweight and fully integrated into the vanilla experience. [/*]
[/list][line]
[heading]Requirements[/heading]
[list]
[*][b]SMAPI[/b] (latest version) [/*]
[*][b]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/b][/*]
[*][b]Sunberry Village[/b] is required if you want to process [b]Sunberry Artifacts[/b].[/*]
[/list]

Manifest.Name: Geode Crusher Opens Artifact Troves
Manifest.Description: Allows the Geode Crusher to open Artifact Troves without visiting Clint.
Manifest.Author: Jeweloki
